meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 观察你的屏幕操作,自动找出重复流程并生成新技能建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手能根据你日常操作自动沉淀成可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Watch your screen, find repeated workflows, auto-suggest new skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to turn your daily habits into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取本地 screenpipe 采集的屏幕记录,按你给的时间窗找出重复的工作流,和仓库里已有技能比对,生成「复用、组合、新技能」三类提案草稿目录,供你审阅后再提升为正式技能。
howto.when: 当你要求分析最近几小时、一天或一周的工作并提出新技能,或找重复工作流的组合配方时触发。需要本地 screenpipe 守护进程在 3030 端口运行,否则拒绝执行。

say.text: 分析我最近 4 小时的工作,提出新技能
say.note: 先跑 doctor 检查依赖,再聚类比对

say.text: 看看我这周重复做的事,哪些现有技能还没覆盖
say.note: 命中已有技能时改出组合配方草稿

say.text: 把 ~/.autoskill/proposed 里的提案提升为正式技能
say.note: promote 到 skills/<name>/,不覆盖同名

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads your local screenpipe capture, clusters repeated workflows in a time window, compares them with existing skills, and drafts reuse / compose / novel proposals in a staging folder for you to review and promote.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to analyze recent work and propose skills, or find composition recipes for repeated workflows. Needs the screenpipe daemon on localhost:3030, or it refuses to run.

say_en.text: Analyze my last 4 hours of work and propose new skills
say_en.note: Runs doctor, then clusters and matches

say_en.text: Show which repeated workflows existing skills don't cover
say_en.note: Emits composition recipes when skills match

say_en.text: Promote the proposals in ~/.autoskill/proposed to real skills
